text_block_list.text: I'm walking along the beach, when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we got some yakisoba dogs
from that
beach hut!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the owner said it's his most prized
recipe.
We should eat up before they go
cold.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
His most prized recipe?! Okay, let's dig
i—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Aaahhh!

A bird—a black kite—suddenly swoops
down and
steals the yakisoba dog from
Nishino Flower's
hands!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. Well, I guess you can't argue with
Mother
Nature.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Buuut at least it didn't carry you away.
Here, you
can have mine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! A-are you sure you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, go ahead. My horoscope said
I should
stay away from red ginger today
anyhow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You'll actually be doing me a favor by
eating it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, thank you...

The next day at the academy, I run into
Nishino
Flower glancing this way and
that as if searching
for someone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Actually, I'm looking for Sky.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There's something I wanted to give her,
but I
don't know where she could be.

I ask if she's tried looking near the forest
where
they ran into each other
previously.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh—no, I haven't! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But where near the forest... I guess I'll just have to look!

I offer to join Nishino Flower in her
search for
Seiun Sky, and she accepts.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is the last likely spot where
she'd come
to nap, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah—Sky?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Did... did someone just call my
name?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Flower? How come you're out of
breath?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff... Um, I have a present for you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A present? What for?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky, you always behave as if nothing's a
big
deal...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But you gave me your yakisoba dog at
the beach,
and before that, you helped
me find the stuff I'd
lost...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and there was that time you got that
scary
centipede out of the flowerbed for
me too,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I? You youngsters have such
impressive
memories.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's why today, I really
wanted to show
you how much I
appreciate all of it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a flower crown. I wanted to give it to
you
while the buds are in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yep! I was running all over the place!
choice_data_list: 花冠をあげるために頑張ったんだね
感謝の花冠っていいね

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's why you were out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Since you showed up in such a rush, I
figured you
found out I was ditching
class and came to drag
me back.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean you're here playing
hooky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops. Me and my big mouth.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
S-Sky! Geez... What am I going to do
with you?

Seiun Sky puts the flower crown on her
head, and
Nishino Flower escorts her
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm really happy with how it
turned
out!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks again, Sky, for everything you've
done for
me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha. You're overthinking all this.
Not that I
mind, though.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even if I am overthinking it... I was really
happy
when you helped me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...It was nothing. Really.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Sky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? N-nothing. Anyhoo...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the crown. And since you
came all
the way here, how's about
relaxin' a little?

The sunlight shines gently through the
trees as
Seiun Sky and Nishino Flower
relax for a while.
